Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the comparative logic. After correctly gathering that Victor Schertzinger (Road to Singapore) was born in 1888 and Giorgi Shengelaia (Melodies of Vera Quarter) was born in 1937, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Shengelaia is older. Since 1888 precedes 1937, Schertzinger is older, so Road to Singapore has the older director.
